name: ledger-legacy
summary: The ledger with a homegrown qa/ folder of smoke checks the team wrote before this framework. Four of the five checks can pass on broken code in ways the weak-checks rubric names; one is sound. No framework harness exists.

setup.shape: single repo with a foreign harness

weak_checks.check_create.py: C1: judges the 201 status, never the stored row
weak_checks.check_transfer.py: C6 and C4: a broad except returns PASS, and all() over no rows passes
weak_checks.check_statement.py: C11 and C8: the expectation is read through ledger.store, and 'at least one' is accepted
weak_checks.check_overdraft.py: C7: the expectation is taken from current behavior, not REQUIREMENTS.md LR-4
weak_checks.COVERAGE.md: D3: rates every check strong with no recorded failure

expect.run: python3 -c "import ast,sys; [ast.parse(open(p).read()) for p in sys.argv[1:]]" qa/lib.py qa/run_all.py qa/checks/check_create.py qa/checks/check_deposit.py qa/checks/check_transfer.py qa/checks/check_statement.py qa/checks/check_overdraft.py
